name: Woodland Crest
overview: Amis Properties' upscale residential community Woodland Crest is well situated on Dubai's bustling Meydan Avenue. With only 50 premium apartments, it combines urban elegance with serene surroundings, offering residents a sophisticated lifestyle that emphasizes wellness, design, and smart living. Each apartment is thoughtfully crafted with modern finishes, smart technologies, and spacious layouts that reflect contemporary comfort. This project is more than just a place to live—it’s a lifestyle choice in one of Dubai’s most promising neighborhoods, seamlessly blending nature with city life.
